scope: Independent structural, metadata, provenance, path, decode and SVG-render verification. Browser behavior, visual taste, historical shape certification, licensing clearance and production 3D acceptance are outside this report.

checks.interpretation: Resource references retain their published v4 provenance. Rewrite successors preserve navigation, not confirmation of current mainline appearance. UI pages without a physical asset are listed, not silently counted as covered.

checks.meaning: Godot source-art directory exclusion marker exists; no import or runtime loading was exercised.

limitations: All referenced scene/UI IDs are validated; UI pages without physical-asset mappings are reported separately.
Raster decode checks every PNG/JPG file in the production tree, including any unreferenced files. SVGs are parsed and rendered individually.
No production asset was changed by negative controls; failures are injected only into in-memory catalogs, XML strings and raster byte buffers.
A passing report certifies the above checks for its recorded hashes, not 3D models, exact historical reconstruction, rights clearance, browser rendering or full visual review.
